title: Smoother browsing and safer Windows file operations
notes: On Windows, fman can now handle file operations in protected folders such as Program Files and Windows with a standard UAC prompt, while the rest of the app stays unelevated.
Opening very large directories is more responsive, so the rest of fman remains usable while a huge folder finishes loading.
New on Windows: use Follow shortcut from the command palette to navigate to a .lnk shortcut's destination instead of launching it.
Plugins can now add their own archive settings without breaking fman's built-in support for ZIP, 7z and TAR files.
